subtitle: Apni baat kahein, sune jaayein, aur zaroori madad paayein.
feeling: Haal mein aap kaisa mehsoos kar rahe hain?
fear: Kitni baar chinta ya darr lagta hai?
sleep: Sone mein kitni dikkat ho rahi hai?
daily: Roz ke kaam kitne mushkil hain?
avoidance: Kya darr se logon ya jagahon se bach rahe hain?
legal: Kya kanooni proceedings se stress badha hai?
threat: Kya aapko dhamki mil rahi hai?
safe: Kya abhi aap safe mehsoos karte hain?
support: Kya koi hai jis par bharosa kar sakein?
text: Kya apne shabdon mein kuch batana chahenge?
consentText: Aapke jawaab authorized support team ko wellbeing ke badlav samajhne mein madad karte hain. AI distress ke sanket batata hai; madad ke faisle insaan lete hain. Yeh diagnosis nahi hai. Voice optional hai; acoustic features nikale jaate hain, recording nahi rakhi jaati. Browser transcription bahari service use kar sakta hai. Aap kabhi bhi optional collection band kar sakte hain. Pehle ke records follow-up aur audit ke liye prototype database mein rehte hain.
agree: Main optional wellbeing analysis se sehmat hoon
voiceAgree: Main optional voice processing se bhi sehmat hoon
thanksText: Aapki chinta record ho gayi. Authorized team review karke madad arrange kar sakti hai.
voiceNote: Optional: 90 seconds tak record karein. Submit karne se pehle transcript review ya type karein.
